notes: Covers the full-size SJ Wagoneer (1963-1983) and SJ Grand Wagoneer (1984-1991) only. The 1984-1990 XJ-based compact Wagoneer/Wagoneer Limited (2.5 I4, 2.8 V6, 2.1 turbodiesel, 4.0 I6) is excluded: the EPA file mixes it in as "Cherokee/Wagoneer" (1984-1989) and "Wagoneer Limited"/"Wagoneer 4WD" 4.0 (1989-1990) rows, and the 1987/1989 Jeep brochures and jeep.com history list "Wagoneer Limited (XJ)" next to Grand Wagoneer. NHRA has no rows for this model. Archive dating trap: oldcarbrochures.org's "1965 Wagoneer R3" and "1966 Wagoneer" brochures advertise the new Dauntless V-8 and are 1968+ literature; its "1983 Jeep Wagoneer" is a Mexican VAM brochure. Mexican VAM-built Wagoneers used a VAM 282 six (export, not US) and are excluded. Net HP for AMC V8s/sixes 1974-1983 could not be triple-sourced (brochures from 1974 on give no hp), so hp is null there. Super Wagoneer (1966-1969): 1969 engine not established. Wagoneer Limited (1978-83) used the same engines as the Wagoneer.
